interpretation: Authentic policies from different recorded phases. Historical horizons and no-eagle rules are preserved. Monitoring, validation and wider-development means use different panels; the fixed-map replay score is an illustration, not a final-test result. Cumulative generations count selected warm-start phase positions only.

entries.title: First population
entries.note: Champion of the first random population, evaluated before any breeding. This prototype is a separate experiment from the later 500-generation binary run.

entries.title: Five-generation prototype
entries.note: Five actual generations of 200 chickens with three training maps each. This prototype is a separate experiment, not five extra generations in the final policy's ancestry.

entries.title: Binary road learner
entries.note: Selected native generation 470 of the original binary training and continuation. The historical 60-second episode limit is preserved.

entries.title: Two-hop lookahead
entries.note: Generation 85 of the lookahead branch, inheriting binary generation 470 and 30 motion-sensor generations. The cumulative 585 describes selected phase positions, not an uninterrupted run.

entries.title: Lookahead with memory
entries.note: Actual generation-100 memory policy, selected by the recorded wider population audit. Earlier warm-start phases remain part of its ancestry.

entries.title: Final Variant 1 policy
entries.note: Frozen memory generation 150, selected before the independent FB assessment. Its 1,174 cumulative selected phase positions include multiple warm starts and NEAT population crossover, not one uninterrupted run. Final mean and interval describe 512 held-out maps for this one policy.

additionalEntries.title: Some progress
additionalEntries.note: Actual generation 50 of the binary-sensor phase. The homepage uses this earlier population; the generation-470 replay remains separately available.

additionalEntries.title: Traffic timing
additionalEntries.note: Actual lookahead generation 30; full population. Illustrative map-42 batch high is 1,506, not a benchmark result.
